description: This file defines a customizable Button UI component using React and class-variance-authority for styling. It exports a Button component with various visual variants and sizes, supporting composition with other components via the 'asChild' prop.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: A React forwardRef component representing a customizable button with variant and size options, supporting composition via the 'asChild' prop.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: A React component that renders a button element or Slot for composition, applying styling variants and forwarding refs.
